title: Predictive Scheduling for Efficient Inference-Time Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: Katrina Brown; Aneesh Muppidi; Rana Shahout
research_focus: Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, LoRA / Multi-adapter, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Chain-of-thought reasoning under a fixed per-query token budget over-spends on easy queries and starves hard ones, inflating latency and cost. Prior schedulers rely on surface-level signals (queue length, past runtimes) or single-checkpoint early-termination, missing a pre-run estimate of the reasoning length each query actually needs.
problem_statement.zh: chain-of-thought 推理在固定每筆查詢 token budget 下會在簡單問題上過度計算、在困難問題上計算不足，造成延遲與成本上升。先前的 scheduler 仰賴表層訊號（佇列長度、過往執行時間）或單一檢查點 early-termination，缺少在生成前估計各查詢所需推理長度的能力。

key_innovation.en: Predictive Scheduling: lightweight pre-run predictors built on intermediate transformer hidden states (an MLP per layer) or a LoRA-fine-tuned classifier on raw question text, which estimate each query's optimal reasoning length or difficulty class before generation. A layer-wise analysis identifies middle layers (12-17, best layer 16) as carrying the strongest predictive signal. A greedy batch allocator then distributes a fixed total token budget by iteratively assigning 16-token windows to the query with highest predicted marginal accuracy gain.
key_innovation.zh: Predictive Scheduling：在生成前以輕量預測器估計各查詢所需的推理長度或難度類別，採用兩種方案——以中間 transformer hidden states 為輸入的 per-layer MLP，以及對原始題目文字進行 LoRA fine-tune 的分類器。Layer-wise 分析指出中段 layer（第 12-17 層、最佳為第 16 層）攜帶最強預測訊號。後續再以 greedy batch allocator 將固定總 token budget 以每次 16 個 token 為步長，配置給預測邊際準確率增益最高的查詢。

key_improvements.en: On GSM8K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, predictive scheduling yields up to 7.9 percentage points absolute accuracy gain over uniform budgeting at identical token cost, closing over 50% of the gap to the oracle. Best MLP-per-layer test correlation reaches Pearson r = 0.742 at layer 16.
key_improvements.zh: 在 GSM8K 上以 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 為基底，predictive scheduling 在相同 token 成本下相較 uniform budgeting 取得最高 7.9 個百分點的絕對準確率提升，並補上與 oracle 之間超過 50% 的差距。Per-layer MLP 的最佳 test 相關係數於第 16 層達 Pearson r = 0.742。

reported_accuracy: Best layer Pearson r = 0.742 (layer 16); +7.9 pp accuracy vs uniform at equal token cost

scope_assumptions.en: Evaluated on a single dataset (GSM8K) with a single base model (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B); predictors are trained per (model, task) and may not transfer; uses a fixed probe-string injection (every 16 tokens up to 256) to derive ground-truth early-stopping labels, capping the modelled reasoning length at 256 tokens; greedy allocator assumes marginal gains are monotonically decreasing per query.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅在單一資料集（GSM8K）與單一基底模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B）上評估；預測器需針對 (模型, 任務) 分別訓練，跨設定移植性未驗證；以固定 probe-string 插入（每 16 token、最多 256 token）取得 early-stopping 標籤，因此所建模的推理長度上限為 256 token；greedy allocator 假設每筆查詢的邊際增益單調遞減。
